notes: False as stated: n = 3 gives 2 matrices ([[3,1],[3,3]], [[3,3],[1,3]]) but A192023(1) = 1 (core Lean A192023.lean: A192023_det_counterexample, A192023_det_mismatch_3..10; no axioms). Corrected form from Kimberling's table in A211795 (w = -x+y+z+2): A192023_main proves for all n >= 2 that #{(w,x,y,z) in [1,n]^4 : w+x = y+z+2} = A192023_wiener (n-1), the Wiener index (half the ordered sum of SimpleGraph.dist) of the comb graph A192023_comb; also A192023_linear (count = a(n-1), a(m) = m(2m^2+6m-5)/3) and A192023_wiener_eq (Wiener index = a(n)). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the modelling of the comb |_|_|...|_| as A192023_comb (Fin n x Fin 2, spine path plus one tooth per spine vertex).
